prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a side impact at intersection. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1155; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents the injured party in connection with the side-impact collision that occurred at a signalized intersection involving your insured. Our client sustained injuries that are currently under medical evaluation and treatment, and the full extent of those injuries and the resulting losses are still being determined.

Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office. Do not contact our client directly, either by telephone, in writing, or in person. Any contact from your company or its representatives should be routed to our firm.

We request that you provide, within thirty days, a certified copy of the declarations page for every policy issued to your insured that may apply to this loss, including the bodily injury and property damage limits and any excess or umbrella coverage.

We also ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes the claim file, recorded statements, photographs, vehicle data, repair or total loss appraisals, dashcam or telematics footage, and any witness information in your possession. Please confirm in writing that these materials are being retained.
